g.title: HAI_QSP
g.text: High-Altitude Illness — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Map
AMS · HACE · HAPE — one inspired PO₂, three defences, three time constants
ventilation (minutes→days, limited by acid-base) · hypoxic pulmonary vasoconstriction (seconds, uneven) · cerebral vasodilation (seconds, paid from the craniospinal volume buffer)

g.title: cluster_env
g.text: ① ENVIRONMENT — the only exogenous variable

g.title: cluster_acid
g.text: ③ ACID-BASE — the rate-limiting step of acclimatisation

g.title: cluster_pulm
g.text: ⑦ HYPOXIC PULMONARY VASOCONSTRICTION — defence 2 (seconds), and it is UNEVEN

g.title: cluster_oedema
g.text: ⑧ CAPILLARY STRESS FAILURE & ALVEOLAR FLOODING (HAPE)

g.title: cluster_brain
g.text: ⑨ CEREBRAL CIRCULATION, OEDEMA & INTRACRANIAL PRESSURE (AMS / HACE)

g.title: cluster_fluid
g.text: ⑫ FLUID & NEUROHUMORAL — the AMS/anti-AMS switch

g.title: PH2O
g.text: fixed cost, fraction rises with h

g.title: DIFF
g.text: β = slope of the O₂ content curve

g.title: VQMIS
g.text: log SD widens with HPV & oedema

g.title: AADO2
g.text: 9 mmHg at sea level → 3 mmHg on the summit
(the gradient NARROWS as the driving pressure falls)

g.title: SAO2
g.text: STEEP part of the curve below 60 mmHg

g.title: PAO2ART->PASMC
g.text: LOOP 1: flooding → shunt → hypoxaemia → more HPV → more overperfusion

g.title: CO2REAC
g.text: at a summit P_aCO₂ of 13 mmHg

g.title: CO2RES
g.text: and NEGATIVE on the first night

g.title: DHYP
g.text: linear in DESATURATION, not in PO₂

g.title: PLASMA
g.text: τ ≈ 40 h — the FAST, fake adaptation
★ week-1 Hct rise is water, not red cells ★

g.title: HETERO
g.text: fraction of the bed that CAN constrict

g.title: MUSCADPT
g.text: volume ↓, mass loss at extreme altitude

g.title: LOOPG
g.text: controller gain rises with HVR and VAH

g.title: VO2MAX
g.text: V̇O₂max falls ≈10 % per 1000 m above 1500 m

g.title: PCT
g.text: Na⁺/H⁺ exchanger NHE3 + CA II / CA IV

g.title: CHOROID
g.text: active CSF pH regulation, τ ≈ 8 h

g.title: P50NET
g.text: ★ NET P₅₀ IS NON-MONOTONIC IN ALTITUDE ★
curve re-crosses and ends LEFT of normal
on the summit — positioned for the LUNG

g.title: HCTOPT
g.text: S_aO₂ CANCELS — the optimum does NOT

g.title: PCAP
g.text: (= 1/(1−a) only if the other bed never constricts)
HPV strength only sets the speed

g.title: HAPEDX
g.text: susceptibles on rapid ascent with exertion

g.title: CBF
g.text: +20 % acutely, back to baseline by day 5

g.title: CBV
g.text: the first thing that fills the skull

g.title: VASOG
g.text: splenium of the corpus callosum on DWI

g.title: PVIN
g.text: same ΔV, different ICP — the whole

g.title: ATAXIA
g.text: (tandem gait; the one exam that matters)

g.title: DEATH
g.text: commonest medical causes of altitude death)

g.title: FLUIDRET
g.text: Fluid retention, peripheral / facial / periorbital oedema

g.title: ACZ
g.text: F 0.95, V 15 L, CL 2.1 L/h, deep RBC pool

g.title: ACZPD3
g.text: slows CO₂ transport, widens a–A gradient

g.title: ACZMECH
g.text: it MOVES THE FLOOR DOWN faster than
it moves the operating point down

g.title: DEX
g.text: (8 mg then 4 mg q6h for HACE)

g.title: DEXWARN
g.text: it does not touch ANY term in the
gas-exchange chain — it breaks the gauge

g.title: TAD
g.text: TADALAFIL 10 mg bid / SILDENAFIL 50 mg tid

g.title: SAL
g.text: CLEARANCE only, no effect on P_cap

g.title: GAMOW
g.text: +105 mmHg at 2 psi = a simulated descent

g.title: DESCENT
g.text: the only intervention that removes the cause;

g.title: HAPEREC
g.text: Recovery: complete within 48 h of descent

g.title: AVOIDA
g.text: (they blunt the hypoxic drive at night)

g.title: EPAS1
g.text: BLUNTED erythropoiesis, normal Hb at 4000 m

g.title: ANDEAN
g.text: Andean pattern: high Hb, high SaO₂,

g.title: ETHIOP
g.text: normal Hb AND normal SaO₂ — mechanism unknown
